objective: Track 2, unit 5: move the two inline zip Lambdas, the App stack's origin-verify authorizer and the Auth stack's pre-sign-up trigger, from python3.12 to python3.15, so every Python the app deploys matches the 3.15 Lambda image that Renovate's python runtime group brings.
acceptance_criteria: Start gate: this spec's Director PR has merged, and the branch is cut from a main that holds it.
Test-first: commit the failing tests alone before the implementation. They fail today because both functions synthesize Runtime python3.12.
app-stack.test.ts's origin-verify test and auth-stack.test.ts's pre-sign-up test expect Runtime python3.15.

A new test synthesizes every stack in every synth mode the suite already uses and asserts that every AWS::Lambda::Function either has PackageType Image and no Runtime, or has Runtime python3.15. Nothing that synthesizes today may be skipped to make it pass.

infra/lib/app-stack.ts and infra/lib/auth-stack.ts use lambda.Runtime.PYTHON_3_15. Their inline code is unchanged; the PR body says why it runs on 3.15 (standard-library hmac and os, and boto3, which the managed 3.15 runtime includes).
The PR body carries a before/after synth diff of cdk.out/*.template.json for every stack: only the two functions' Runtime changes. No resource is added, removed or replaced, and no logical id moves.

infra/iam/** is unchanged: changing a function's runtime is lambda:UpdateFunctionConfiguration, which CloudFormation's role already holds. Every cfn-exec-policy, iam-policy and permissions-boundary test passes in every domain mode.
npm run build, npm run lint, npm test and npm run synth pass in infra/. Nobody runs cdk deploy.

Not in this unit: setup-python's python-version, docker/backend.Dockerfile's base image (Renovate's python runtime PR, merged unchanged) and mypy's python_version (a Director manifest edit after that PR).
wiki/CodeContext/Modules/0x00a-architecture-infra.md states the zip Lambdas' runtime if it names one, and names no python3.12.
